meta_title: Gas Parts Direct | Plumbers' Merchant Leicester
meta_description: Gas Parts Direct in Leicester supplies boiler spares, gas parts, and plumbing materials. Fast local stock, trade prices, and expert advice. Visit or call today.
hero_eyebrow: Trade & DIY Supplies — Boiler Parts & Gas Spares
hero_subhead: Get the right gas and plumbing parts first time — saving you costly return visits and wasted hours on site.
services_heading: Complete Gas & Plumbing Parts Supply Across Leicester
services_subhead: From boiler spares and gas valves to copper fittings and heating controls, we stock everything the trade needs to get the job done.

services.title: Boiler Spares & Parts
services.desc: We carry a wide range of boiler spares for leading brands including Baxi, Worcester Bosch, Ideal, and Vaillant. Get the part you need from our trade counter without waiting days for a delivery.

services.title: Gas Components & Valves
services.desc: From gas solenoid valves and burner assemblies to injectors and thermocouple kits, our shelves are stocked with genuine and quality-equivalent gas components. Suitable for domestic and light commercial appliances.

services.title: Central Heating Controls
services.desc: We supply programmers, room thermostats, zone valves, and smart heating controls from trusted brands. The right controls help your customers save energy and reduce bills.

services.title: Plumbing Fittings & Pipework
services.desc: Our range covers copper, plastic, and push-fit fittings alongside flexible hoses, isolation valves, and pipe supports. Everything you need for a clean, compliant installation.

services.title: Hot Water & Cylinder Parts
services.desc: We stock immersion heaters, cylinder thermostats, pressure relief valves, and expansion vessels for unvented and vented hot water systems. Get replacements over the counter the same day.

services.title: Flue Systems & Accessories
services.desc: Concentric and twin-wall flue systems, terminals, brackets, and seals are available for collection or advice at our Leicester trade counter. Ensure every installation meets current regulations.

about_pullquote: We're here so local trades spend less time sourcing and more time earning.
about_para_1: Gas Parts Direct was established to give Leicester's plumbing and heating engineers a reliable local source for gas parts, boiler spares, and plumbing materials — without the long lead times of online-only suppliers. Based on Thurmaston Boulevard, LE4, we're conveniently located for tradespeople across Leicester and the surrounding Leicestershire area.
about_para_2: We pride ourselves on holding genuine stock, offering honest technical advice, and treating every customer — whether a sole trader or a larger heating firm — with the same professionalism. Our team understands the pressure of being on site with a faulty appliance, which is why fast counter service is at the heart of everything we do.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Tradespeople Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant local merchant — always have what I need in stock. Far quicker than ordering online and the staff actually know their stuff. Won't go anywhere else for boiler parts now.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Popped in for a Baxi PCB and they had it on the shelf. Saved my afternoon completely. Counter staff were helpful and the price was fair. Highly recommended to any heating engineer in Leicester.
reviews.author: Jason R.

reviews.text: Great little trade counter — friendly, knowledgeable, and well-stocked. Managed to get a flue terminal and zone valve within minutes of arriving. This place is a genuine asset to local plumbers.
reviews.author: Dave H.
